answer: Work waits on the zenith until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the summit of the next round. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. What survives to the kernel is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
